EPS of $6.20 on revenue of $75.17B during the quarter.

The Nvidia supplier benefitted from a higher price for DRAM and NAND flash memory chips amid sustained demand growth from AI infrastructure investments, leading to a 257% year-over-year rise in revenue during its second quarter, while its operating profit soared more ‌than sixfold to a record high.

Despite this, investors were left disappointed as the company’s quarterly results fell short of analysts' expectations. The stock has fallen nearly 6% so far this year, underperforming the 11% rise in the broader S&P 500 Index.
However, long-term agreements and multi-year contracts have kept analysts bullish. Seeking Alpha and Wall Street analysts rated the stock a Buy and above.

“The market is already anticipating record earnings from SK hynix. However, I am especially interested in understanding how long the company can maintain such high prices and margins. Much of the valuation for the future will depend on this,”
Seeking Alpha analyst Agar Capital, adding that “there's a good chance it will beat estimates because memory prices (DRAM and NAND) are rising due to supply chain shortages and strong demand.”
BofA analysts believe the company will offer up “bullish guidance,” due in part to the successful ramp-up of 12-hi HBM4.

SK Hynix is preparing to distribute approximately 16 trillion won ($12 billion) to shareholders through a special dividend funded by gains from its investment in Japanese memory-chip maker Kioxia Holdings
, South Korea's DongA Ilbo newspaper reported Monday.
For investors, the potential dividend would provide a substantial one-time cash return while highlighting the value SK Hynix realized from its investment in a rival memory-chip producer.

Investors will also focus on any comment regarding further plans for its subsidiary, Solidigm. Earlier this month, SK Hynix decided to pause a planned U.S. listing for its Solidigm chip unit due to ⁠market volatility, especially after Seoul reportedly raised concerns that the deal could undermine shareholder interests.
The stock was trading over 3% higher in the afternoon on Monday.
